title: ID0369673-DC/Si-D/AT[170001723] - Converter PowerON=False during charging
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Converter cannot supply output, PowerON = False, after positively performing ConverterGrouping and Fastshutdown check
Root cause:
Possible quality issue
Solution:
Send converter back to factory for investigation
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
The supplied converter that was ordered for replacement also has an error. Converters had to be replaced, removed and installed several times, and load tests had to be carried out.

additional_info.subject: ID0369673-DC/Si-D/AT[170001723] - Converter PowerON=False during charging CRM:00315001600
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel and Johannes﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R4 170001723
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
cLymeL
Problem Description
: PowerConverter does not supply output current/power during charging session but is able to perform ConverterGrouping and Fastshutdown check, this means that it does not have an error-flag.
Troubleshooting
:
Summary of the previous ticket and this one:
In the previous ticket we had a converter with an error and swapped with the neighbor converter to confirm that we didn't have a cabling issue. It is confirmed since the converter with error now shows the same behaviour in a different position.
As such I recommended to replace the converter.
Summary of yesterday's replacement:
After Daniel's support in replacing the bad converter with the new one, the charger was operational and ready to charge.
This is where the problem occurred:
As you can see here, in Group 2, where the converter was replaced, it cannot go to  “PowerON = True”, it stays “False” and as such we cannot provide the power from the other groups since we are still waiting for this one to complete his starting/supplying process.
As such, we swapped this new converter with another one from DC1:
Result is the same, we still find the PowerOn = False, instead of True and power being supplied. As such DC3 group cannot supply power.
Since this converter is not powering on, there seems to be a problem with the output, something we cannot test ourselves by opening it since it would void the warranty.
I will reach out to QM for this and let you know an answer.
I already had a meeting with them once and what they told me is that since the error is very rare since now, it's will take sometime to perform a deep investigation.
Do you perhaps have a converter from a warehouse charger that you can use for the moment?
Otherwise the customer will lose 20kW, I hope it's not very harsh to deal with this.
I will do the RMAs and send a reply here.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0369673
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not

the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
